references.text: Here reference is made to Psalm 2:7 where God proclaims the king as his son, which foreshadows the Messiah, the Son of God.
Luke 3:22 describes a similar event at Jesus' baptism, where God confirms Jesus' sonship.
In Matthew 3:17 a voice from heaven is heard confirming that Jesus is God's beloved Son, parallel to Mark 1:11.
Mark 1:11 and Mark 9:7 share a similar heavenly confirmation of Jesus' identity as the Son of God.
In John 12:28-30 Jesus hears a voice from heaven confirming his relationship with the Father, similar to the confirmation in Mark 1:11.
